inputs.text: [excited][happily] The SMALL animals, they survive! [pauses] The little ones who can hide, who don't need so, so much food. [amazed] And the BIRDS? They survive too. [curious] You know why? Because birds are REAL dinosaurs! [pauses] Wild, right?

[playful][confident] REALLY! [pauses] And here's something even wilder: next time you see a pigeon on the street, or a sparrow, or a crow — YOU'RE LOOKING AT A DINOSAUR! [amazed] Today's birds are the babies-babies-babies of the dinosaurs from back then. [softly] Life never stopped. [pauses] It just changed shape. And that's why the dinosaurs never really left. They're everywhere! [happily] They fly through the sky — pretty cool, huh?
[happily] Yes. The pigeon is a dino. I love it.
